content: The Language of Rejection: NLP Analysis: Multi-model NLP pipeline analyzing sentiment patterns in job rejection emails. Compares lexicon-based (VADER, TextBlob, AFINN) vs transformer models (RoBERTa, DistilBERT) with SHAP explainability. Discovered the 4:1 positive-to-apology ratio for warm rejections and revealed 0.38 correlation gap between model paradigms. Interactive Streamlit dashboard with word-level attribution analysis.
